summaryZh: Ray 实验室发展算法，根据每日锥形束 CT 的变化判断何时需要自动重新制定放疗计划。团队也开发回顾性临床大数据的自动分析工具。

evidence.quote: Dr. Xenia Ray Dr. Ray’s research is focused on the development of algorithms to help determine when automated re-planning should be performed in patients undergoing radiotherapy based on changes detected on daily cone-beam CT images. Such algorithms are vital to the optimal clinical implementation of adaptive radiotherapy. She is also working to develop automated tools to facilitate big-data analyses of retrospective clinical data included batch automated replanning via RapidPlan, plan comparison, DVH extraction, and timing data. Explore the Lab People Learn more about the dedicated team in Dr. Xenia Ray's lab. Meet Our Team Publications Explore the latest publications from Dr. Xenia Ray's lab.
